purpose: Source consistency checks and narrow movement samples; no field review, legal certification, or whole-corridor approval.
scope_caveat: Samples test junction movement rules only; adjoining edges and current signs may differ.
sampling_method: Two distinct eligible same-way nodes nearest route-index quartiles per route, both directions; selection independent of observed result. Unknown, restricted and junction-traversal nodes are excluded.
